adopted_numeric_reference.description: Reference = the recorded TensorLBM selection (A1, MRT+sponge) at the same resolution; obtained = the OSS-selection arms (A2 BGK, A4 MRT-no-sponge). Kernel-level cross-check (executed OSS source vs TensorLBM kernel) is the tighter row. Tolerance is the owner 15% standard for selection-level contrast; the kernel row uses 1e-6.
